abstracts.abstract: The committee on Environment and Natural Resources to whom was referred the petition (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 582) of Peter J. Durant, Donald R. Berthiaume, Jr. and Bruce E. Tarr for legislation relative to the Ware river watershed advisory committee, report the accompanying bill (Senate, No. 2570).

bill.title: An Act relative to the Ware River watershed advisory committee

action.description: Committee reported that the matter be placed in the Orders of the Day for the next session

posted_text:
💧 Environment & Climate
MA S2570 — Ware River Advisory Committee Gets a Boost

The state is changing the makeup of the Ware River watershed advisory committee to include representatives from local snowmobile clubs, equestrian groups, and mountain biking associations, expanding its reach to better reflect local outdoor recreation interests.

July 13, 2026: Committee reported that the matter be placed in the Orders of the Day for the next session.
